description: Fetch a single Mercury motor by id or slug, including pricing, decoded shaft/control/start facts, a specSource summary, normalized stock, and deep-link URL. Model-code fitment must be confirmed against the buyer’s transom before ordering; null means not stated. specSource flags database rigging presence; individual fields may still be model-code decoded. inStock/stockQuantity are the normalized stock signal; availability is the catalog label.
name: get_motor
